title: mockupPng
responsibility: Add a stable capture identity to PNG metadata while preserving its pixels.

inputs.name: mockupPng.bytes
inputs.description: Complete PNG screenshot produced by the mockup renderer.

inputs.name: mockupPng.slot
inputs.description: Stable identifier for the option, state, and viewport whose screenshot is being stored.

outputs.name: mockupPng
outputs.description: PNG bytes with the original image pixels and a text chunk naming the slot.
